title: Oregon City courier.

items.notes: Council bond/refunding, jitney rail competition; New Post Office? reports Treasury recommendation $55,000 building plus $10,000 site, not actual construction or location; Hayck funeral at Myers & Brady. No target number.
County/suburban correspondence, dairy, Adams Dept Store and rail/Portland Flour ads; no target location finding.

Justice-court rooms reopened after recent midnight fire (Nut Club Meets), no number in this item. Willamette Valley Southern stock meeting; general local material. Potential tie to p5 justice-court building requires explicit link; no 503/505 finding.
Holman and Randall undertakers Fifth/Main; Williams Bros office 612 Main. Editorial water frontage relates Sixth/Water and Suspension Bridge, not target storefront. WJ Wilson Tenth/Main.

Geo W Buck new store Seventh at Elevator.

Refunding bonds; foundry manufacturing proposal without fixed address; Grandstand wind damage at Gladstone; unrelated regional fires. No target storefront fact.

Fashion/national ads, First National Bank, militia and county/local briefs; no target address finding.

Holman/Randall Fifth/Main and Williams Bros612. Editorial continues $55,000 post-office proposal, no actual appropriation/building location. Cemetery plat and Water west-end-grade controversy distinct from target street-numbering map.
Schilling617, Scripture/May Fifth, Holman/Randall Fifth/Main; local/church notices and shopping ads. No 503/505 finding.

IMPORTANT local notice: T P Randall sold his interest in Holman-Randall undertaking establishment to R L Holman. Schilling617; Dr W E Hempstead moves office to Electric hotel annex Sixth/Main. Scripture/May Fifth. Retiring fire-chief motor apparatus proposal. Enlargement also confirms church social at Mrs. Cannon home, 509 Fifth Street; distinct from 509 Main and 100-block Fifth.
Picture ads Champion Smith/Telford502, Streibig528, Wilkinson612; Raasch/Lamb and laundry unnumbered. Sawmill prospect discussions broader valley, not target property. No target-number finding.
Electric Store617 and Holman/Randall Fifth/Main. Newspaper ownership statement includes Holman Estate Portland; no merger with undertaker. Legal/classified references no target-number finding.

Council considers liquid-asphalt street protection and orders investigation, not completed paving. Cement street-corner monuments proposed. Jitney franchise debate; postal-business increase no premises. No target-number finding.
Sewer District10 assessment debate and Lovve property assessment court case, general civic context. No target storefront number or ownership bridge.
Directory reconfirms 507/509/511/519/527/612, Scripture/May Fifth and Holman/Randall Fifth/Main. New Wilhoit Hotel is outside target area; no target-number finding.
New Fire Plans Here proposes truck conversion; no apparatus purchase/installation proved. Busch furniture, First National and general material. No target-number finding.
Editorials, advertising, Williams Bros612 Main, Wilson Tenth/Main. No target-number finding.

G Company Busch hall rental dispute and risk of losing hall; no street number or actual relocation. Mayor seeks municipal-lighting information, not installation. Schilling617; Scripture/May Fifth; Holman/Randall joint ads persist. GeoW Buck Seventh/Elevator.
Picture ads502 Champion Smith/Telford,528 Streibig,612 Wilkinson; Dr G F Anderson now prints414 Main. Raasch/Lamb and laundry unnumbered. A Buenday home fire is Willamette, not Main.

Legal notices, classifieds and Electric Store advertising reviewed. Holman/Randall Fifth and Main ad persists after the April 6 sale notice; no independent partnership evidence. No direct 503/505 item identified.

Cataract Hose Company housewarming planned April 20 in new quarters on Main; W. P. Hawley Sr. invited. Ninth/Main interurban accident involving John Patterson. Council reports Seventh/Main drinking fountain out of service; proposed freight depot/franchise is not completed construction. No direct 503/505 item.

Suspension bridge guy cable failure and ordered replacement/inspection. Artisans gathering at Busch Hall and planned Main Street parade to Sixth. M. E. Dunn county treasurer candidacy does not establish business occupancy. No direct 503/505 item.

Directory repeats Bradley 507, Brightbill 509, Harding 511, Theroux 519, Price 527, Wilkinson and Schooley 612 Main; Scripture/May Fifth and Holman/Randall Fifth/Main advertisements. Mountain View house construction unrelated to target frontage. No direct 503/505 item.
Full-page Adams Department Store Easter advertisement, including basement bargain department; no numbered address.

Fire Draws Crowd: old Selling house moved to Fifth/Water, owned by Charman estate and occupied by Mrs. R. F. Wood as lodging house, attic fire Sunday; separate from Main frontage. To Fix Paving: PRL&P superintendent to inspect new freight switch under construction and Worswick/Main surface breaks. Miller & Obst clothing, Busch, Price and other shopping notes, no exact target number. Joint Holman/Randall ad persists.
Full-page Miller & Obst Easter clothing advertisement; no numbered address. Firm is not identified as Wolf & Miller.
Editorials and advertisements. W. J. Wilson & Company Tenth/Main; Williams Brothers office 612 Main; Scripture/May Fifth; joint Holman/Randall Fifth/Main. No direct 503/505 item.

Local news, obituaries, election/liquor debate; Schilling 617 Main, Burmeister/Andresen Suspension Bridge Corner. Cottage construction on John Adams Street unrelated to target frontage. No direct 503/505 item.
Larsen Tenth/Main. Armory Plan Sprung proposes Monroe Street block; not an accomplished relocation. Hotel Belle Milwaukie trial and regional reports, no target storefront item.
County court road-district expenditure lists, political notices and Frank Busch block advertisement reviewed; no target numbered address or ownership transfer identified.

Picture advertisements visually checked: Champion Smith/Telford 502 Main, Streibig 528, Wilkinson shop 612, Miller/Obst Main/Seventh, Oregon City Garage Main/Fourth, Foundry Fourth/Water, Oregon City Laundry and Raasch/Lamb pool/billiards unnumbered. Anderson chiropractic advertisement in this issue does not print 414. No direct 503/505 item.

County expenditure continuation and legal/classified notices reviewed. Electric Store Beaver Building 617 Main. Home board/rooms classified 1205 Main. Fashion Livery stock sale remains surplus language, not closure. No direct 503/505 item.

Price Brothers display ad explicitly Sixth/Main; Bannon Masonic Temple; joint Holman/Randall ad. Block 72 Idaho Building sale is unrelated to target Block 4. Grand Theatre program and county reports, no direct 503/505 item.

Council extortion allegations, proposed relocation of county paving plant to Parkplace, canal-wall construction, and proposed men's resort. Oswego arson trial separate from target frontage. Charlotte Dunn/Lee M. Dunn divorce is not a business or M. E. Dunn identity link.

Directory repeats Bradley 507, Brightbill 509, Harding 511, Theroux 519, Price 527, Wilkinson/Schooley 612 Main; Scripture/May Fifth, Miller/Obst Seventh/Main. Gladstone Laundry entry remains distinct from Oregon City Laundry. No direct 503/505 item.

Wants Bridge Repairs: north-side guy wire repaired early this week; wider bridge reconstruction remains proposed, including lowering walk to Main Street level. Company G still described as Busch Hall lessee donating drill hall for dance. No target address item.

Mr. Hawley Entertained reports Cataract Hose Company banquet actually held Thursday in his honor; no numbered new quarters given. W. J. Wilson Tenth/Main and Williams Brothers office 612. General editorial and Canby cheese-factory material.

Schilling 617 Main. Thomas Bentley supervising Hawley plant addition, residence Twelfth/Washington; Crown-Willamette Coos Bay machinery proposed for transfer. Small mill fire and Hayhurst home fire at Redlands are separate from Main frontage. Mrs. M. E. Dunn social visit not occupancy evidence.
Picture ads repeat Champion Smith/Telford 502, Streibig 528, Wilkinson 612 Main; Miller/Obst Seventh/Main, garage Fourth/Main. Raasch/Lamb and Oregon City Laundry unnumbered. No direct 503/505 item.

No Increase in Rent: Frank Busch dropped proposed $10/month Company G hall rental increase; no displacement demonstrated. Armory prospects still proposed Cross block Monroe/John Q. Adams/Twelfth/Thirteenth. Electric Store 617 Main; classified board/rooms 1205 Main. Legal notices no target parcel.

Council continuation: PRL&P Main Street repair dispute, ordered rock for Seventeenth/Abernethy, cleanup/unsafe-building inspection including condemning old woolen mill, not target storefront. Busch Hall boxing. Mrs. M. R. Dunn Seventh/John Adams birthday notice not assumed M. E. Dunn business identity. No direct 503/505 item.

Council grants Hedrick half-year pool/billiard license without address; proposed municipal light plant, Main north-end survey and armory donation. Hawley payroll expansion and ongoing plant addition. No numbered target occupancy or completed target alteration.
Directory repeats Bradley 507, Brightbill 509, Harding 511, Theroux 519, Price 527 and Wilkinson/Schooley 612 Main; joint undertaking ad, successful Busch Hall dance. No direct 503/505 item.

Full-page Geo. W. Buck & Co. furniture enlargement sale, Seventh Street at elevator, A. D. Flannigan manager; explicitly not closing or quitting. Sale wording not evidence of closure or target storefront.
Editorials, obituaries and advertisements; W. J. Wilson Tenth/Main, Williams office 612 Main. Camas mill strike is not local storefront occupancy. No direct 503/505 item.

Hawley Contract Let: Grace & Rasmussen awarded plant/pulp-mill contract; excavation nearly finished, retaining walls planned along Third Street and from Third to first warehouse; no target alteration. T. P. Randall receiver of Northwestern Association, no new undertaking ownership evidence. Joint undertaking advertisement persists.

Martin Recovers Machine explicitly identifies H. L. Martin at 613 Main in stolen-car recovery notice; address association, not a specified business or residence type. Women's club men's resort remains search for suitable quarters. General fashion, guard and regional news; no direct 503/505 item.

Defective flue at Mrs. Gibbons's South Main home caused Monday alarm, extinguished before damage/fire-department arrival; unnumbered, not assigned to target. Neal & McClatchie jewelry five doors west of elevator. John Roppell moved from Fifth/Monroe to upper Fifth residence. Schilling 617 Main. No direct 503/505 item.

Picture ads repeat Champion Smith/Telford 502, Streibig 528, Wilkinson 612, garage Fourth/Main, Miller/Obst Seventh/Main; Oregon City Laundry and Raasch/Lamb unnumbered. Joint undertaking ad persists. No direct 503/505 item.

Council continuation discusses municipal light plant and Main Street cleanliness; shopping, school and political reports reviewed. Bannon Masonic Building. No direct 503/505 item.

Election polling places include Oregon City No. 9 Eby's garage and No. 10 harness shop corner Seventh/Main, without shop proprietor; do not assign to Wolf & Miller. Memorial Day Main Street/bridge route, fishing dispute, men's resort support without location. No direct 503/505 item.

Milwaukie council dispute distinct from Oregon City. Proposed Crown-Willamette tunnel under government locks, site established but not completed. Larsen Tenth/Main and joint undertaking ads; no direct 503/505 item.
Industry/commodity reports, Oswego cement plant, West Linn new fire house Sunset/Walnut, county schools; no target storefront. Bowery tailor-shop fire is syndicated anecdote, not Oregon City.

Bank of Commerce opposite courthouse statement says opened December 20, 1915. Picture ads Champion Smith/Telford 502, Streibig 528, Wilkinson 612, Schilling 617 Main; Raasch/Lamb and laundry unnumbered. Wilhoit hotel rebuilding outside target area. No direct 503/505 item.
Full-page CC Store mill/factory sale May 15–27. No street number, ownership transfer or building change supplied.

Electric Store 617 Main cooking-school ad; Mrs. S. McClatchie Eighth/Main above Harris grocery; council meeting proposed grade ordinances Main Seventeenth/Eighteenth and Seventeenth. Fashion Livery surplus stock notice and legal notices; no direct 503/505 item.

Men's resort committee solicits support without selected quarters. Olson Was Alarmed narrative gives Andresen/Beaver building spatial references but is explicitly framed as doubtful tale; not used as verified building-layout evidence. Shopping/Frank Busch ads, no direct 503/505 item.

Council granted special three-month permit to remove Raasch and Lamb pool hall from Main Street room in Andresen Building to basement of same building, with proposed charter amendment; permission, not completed move. Main Seventeenth/Eighteenth grades passed second reading, Tenth sewer postponed. No target street number supplied.

Directory repeats Bradley 507, Brightbill 509, Harding 511, Theroux 519, Price 527, Wilkinson/Schooley 612 Main. County expenditure lists and rural reports reviewed; Scripture/May payment not street-address evidence. No direct 503/505 item.
